text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You got injured,
so I took her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Did I not warm up enough...?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Maybe it's because you didn't give me enough love, Trainer-kun♪
choice_data_list: I-I don't think that's right either.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Maybe it's because you didn't give me enough love, Trainer-chan♪
choice_data_list: I-I don't think that's right either.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Well, it wasn't anything serious,
so shall we get back to training?
choice_data_list: I want you to rest for now.
You're not overdoing it, are you?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? But to repay
everyone's love, I have to train—
choice_data_list: Don't push yourself too hard just to meet their expectations, okay?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I guess I have no choice...
I'll take your worry as a sign of love, then.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Once this injury heals, I'll have to train double-time
to make up for all the love I've received...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Not at all!
As long as I have the power of love, this much is—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should just rest after all...
*sigh*... Love really is tough...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because Loves Only You's injury worsened,
we called an end to training.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course!
The power of love is amazing, after all!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Going all out is out of the question, of course,
but there shouldn't be any problem as long as I pace myself."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's go live up to everyone's love!
